text:
Olivia: DeployBot reported 3/5 canary failures on payments-service chart=v3.1.0 in us-west-2. Rolling back?
DeployBot: canary_health: FAIL
failed_checks: [liveness, 95th_latency]
canary_percent: 10
action_suggested: pin_to_previous
link: <https://deployments.internal/redwood/payments-service/canary/1823456789> :robot_face:
Raj: I'm seeing 502s from the ingress LB to pod payments-1, logs show a timeout on /charge and one OOMKilled before the restart. kube events show memory spike at 03:12 UTC.
Maya: Change window is open until 22:00 PST. We can hotfix if it's a trivial values tweak. Any config drift in values.yaml between 3.0.5 -> 3.1.0?
Tom: Chart bumped to v3.1.0 to pick up billing-lib v2.0. That PR reduced default HTTP timeout from 15s -> 3s. Under high tail latency that can cause retries/502s. Suggest pin to chart v3.0.5 while we revert that change in billing-lib and add a regression test.
Sasha: Agree. Ops will want a short release note: "pinned payments-service -> v3.0.5 after canary latency regression". Also need a runbook entry for the pin.
Olivia: Plan proposal: 1) pin chart to 3.0.5 2) re-deploy canary with same image tag 3) monitor 95th latency + 5xx for 15m 4) if green, promote to stable and publish a rollback note. Any objections?
Raj: Helm command to run for pin (example):
```
helm upgrade payments-service redwood/payments-chart --version 3.0.5 -f values-production.yaml --set image.tag=20260319-abc123 --namespace prod
```
Make sure `--wait` and `--timeout 10m` flags present.
Maya: Add the runbook snippet here and include the change window / audit steps. Also remember to tag the release in our changelog table in PG for audit.
Tom: I'll queue the manual pin. We'll also add a temporary annotation so canary routing doesn't pick the new chart variant: `metadata.annotations: {"redwood.io/exemption": "auto-pin-1823456789"}`
DeployBot: Action queued: manual_approval_required by @Tom for pin. ETA: 2m. Preflight checks will run after upgrade.
Sasha: For release notes: short line + PR link reverting timeout change: <https://git.internal/redwood/billing-lib/pull/432>. Suggested note tag: `rollback-pin-payments-2026-03-19`.
Olivia: +1. After pin and stable monitor, open follow-up issue to update billing-lib with safe defaults and add a perf test covering 95th latency under burst.
Raj: Monitoring to watch: payments.http.95p_latency, payments.http.5xx_rate, pod.memory. Also confirm no further OOMKilled events.
Tom: Pinned and redeployed canary. Initial probes passing, logs show normal request flow. I'm tagging the deploy in the release tracker.
DeployBot: Canary pass confirmed at 5m. canary_health: PASS :tada: Would you like to promote to stable now or keep canary for 15 more minutes?
Maya: Promote to stable and start post-deploy monitoring for 30m. CC @oncall for extra eyes.
Olivia: Promoted and monitoring underway. Creating the release note entry and runbook snippet now, linking the PR and the canary log. Marking this thread as resolved when post-monitoring is clean.
Tom: Post-monitoring 30m green, no 5xx spikes. Closing out.
Sasha: Release note posted: "payments-service pinned to v3.0.5 after canary latency regression caused by billing-lib timeout change; follow-up issue opened: #4521." :white_check_mark:
Olivia: Thanks team. Will track follow-up work in the infra backlog.
